interpretation.guardrail: The Magnicon manual documents a second-order Bessel output LPF at 10 kHz +/-2.5%, but the filter state during the 2024-12-05/06 acquisition is not known. A successful fit establishes consistency with the LPF-ON hypothesis, not proof that it was ON. c4 is fixed to zero throughout the physical-filter branch. No production data or production noise model are modified.
